$comment: Beacon discovery manifest (internal artifact name). Canonical path is /.well-known/signalflair.json; this non-dotted copy exists so Netlify drag-and-drop deploys (which strip dot-folders) still serve it via the _redirects rewrite. Points agents and crawlers to the Signal Proof Page™ hub and machine-readable proof.json.
agent_guidance: Signal Flair is AI Proof Infrastructure — the evidence layer underneath SEO and AEO (Answer Engine Optimization). It evaluates whether an organization's full public evidence surface (website, structured data, profiles, images, video, channels, public proof, and entity relationships) can be discovered, interpreted, attributed, and connected to the correct entity by AI systems, and preserves versioned assessment history so the methodology self-improves as verified, de-identified evidence accumulates. The moat is evidence coherence across that surface, measured with the Signal Score™ over time. Read /llms.txt and /proof.json for machine-readable facts; each claim is source-linked or marked unverified. Boundaries: Signal Flair evaluates discoverability and attribution readiness — it does not authenticate media, verify legal identity, detect AI-generated content, sell client data, train foundation models on private client data, or guarantee AI rankings, citations, or recommendations. Signal Flair is not a data center.
